answer: Graduated standing resists sybils: a fresh identity enters with heavily dampened weight and earns full influence only slowly across many honest epochs, so a new seat is near-powerless at first. A swarm spun up in one whisper all starts at the bottom together; none can raid the vault of influence until each pays real time. Like composing a sonnet, standing accrues line by line — mass registration buys only a pile of empty, weightless accounts.
